title: Error made by dropping the weight W in the weak equation (Simon 4.5 (15), steps 4-6)
statement:
Let n, l be natural numbers, cJ >= 0, sigma > 0, 0 <= kappa <= 1, M real, f : R^n -> R^l 1-Lipschitz on closedBall 0 (sigma/2), W : R^n -> R measurable, zeta : R^n -> R any function with ||grad zeta(x)|| <= M for all x, and j in Fin l. Put B1 := ball 0 (3 sigma/8), B2 := ball 0 (sigma/4), |Df(x)|^2 := hsNormSq(fderiv R f x), f^j(y) := (f y)_j and u(x) := <grad f^j(x), grad zeta(x)>.
Assume (H1): for a.e. x, if x is in B1, then W(x) = 0 or 1 <= W(x) <= (1 + kappa)(1 + cJ |Df(x)|^2).
Then, with all integrals taken with respect to Lebesgue measure L^n,
|int_{B2} u - int_{B2} u W| <= M (L^n(B1 cap {W = 0})).toReal + M kappa int_{B2} ||grad f^j|| + 2 cJ M int_{B2} |Df|^2.
lean_statement: ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ) (cJ σ κ M : ℝ) (f : Rn n → Rn ℓ) (W ζ : Rn n → ℝ) (j : Fin ℓ), 0 ≤ cJ → 0 < σ → 0 ≤ κ → κ ≤ 1 → LipschitzOnWith 1 f (closedBall 0 (σ / 2)) → Measurable W → (∀ᵐ x ∂(volume : Measure (Rn n)), x ∈ ball 0 (3 * σ / 8) → W x = 0 ∨ (1 ≤ W x ∧ W x ≤ (1 + κ) * (1 + cJ * hsNormSq (fderiv ℝ f x)))) → (∀ x, ‖gradient ζ x‖ ≤ M) → |(∫ x in ball (0 : Rn n) (σ / 4), inner ℝ (gradient (fun y => f y j) x) (gradient ζ x)) - ∫ x in ball (0 : Rn n) (σ / 4), inner ℝ (gradient (fun y => f y j) x) (gradient ζ x) * W x| ≤ M * (volume (ball (0 : Rn n) (3 * σ / 8) ∩ {x | W x = 0})).toReal + M * κ * (∫ x in ball (0 : Rn n) (σ / 4), ‖gradient (fun y => f y j) x‖) + 2 * cJ * M * ∫ x in ball (0 : Rn n) (σ / 4), hsNormSq (fderiv ℝ f x)
